purpose: Prospective fixed fresh truth, before any cloud/lexical pilot quality ranking.

sources.title: Comparative analysis of diagnostic performance in mammography: A reader study on the impact of AI assistance
Ultrasound classification of non-mass breast lesions following BI-RADS presents high positive predictive value

semantics.support_sets: OR across alternatives; all required quote spans inside one alternative are AND. Distinct blocks are deduplicated by (source_id,block_id), never by quote span.
semantics.context_anchors: Context only, never scored as sufficient support; null queries may return candidates and do not imply automatic model abstention.
semantics.span_offsets: Half-open Unicode code-point offsets within complete canonical block text.
semantics.expected_answer: Human-readable requested facts; scoring must use original source support, not answer string match.
semantics.alternatives: Source-first scan of all 102 canonical blocks; all identified sufficient alternatives retained. Semantic completeness requires independent review before freeze.
semantics.runtime: Original source parser runtime metadata preserved in acquisition manifest; current verifier runtime may differ without rewriting historical metadata.

limits: Two sources and eight agent-authored questions are a nonexhaustive pilot, not clinical or broad domain validation.
No ranking/model calls occurred during acquisition or gold authoring. Root owns prospective freeze and all quality execution.
